integrity: A complete analytic proof is included; standalone exact-rational and floating-point checks are supplementary and do not certify universal quantifiers; no external mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Only uniform existence of a common contraction for fixed positive steps over the specified strongly monotone/Lipschitz operator class and extrapolation weights in [0,1]; not a sharp fixed-step condition, an optimal rate, or a result for approximate resolvents and stochastic or time-varying operators.
title: A sharp tunability threshold for variable positive-extrapolation composition splitting
